summary: Centerra Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a quarterly dividend of C$0.07 per common share, approximately C$13.7 million (~US$9.7 million) in aggregate, payable on September 2, 2026 to holders of record on August 19, 2026. The dividend is declared under the company's regular dividend policy. This is a routine capital allocation disclosure, not a special situation. No M&A, tender, restructuring, or activist element is involved. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer current report under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16 of the Exchange Act. The only event is a predictable quarterly dividend, which is ordinary course. No further action or risk-arb angle is warranted.
